data.exact_reserve_text: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.

prior_year_events.impact_description: reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to provide stability on future loss movements on prior years, enabling releases due to adequacy of reserves.

named_events.loss_description: Reserves established in 2020 proved adequate, enabling releases in 2021.

data.standardized_narrative: In 2021, Syndicate 1975 experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 9.539 million, representing an 11.69% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by the adequacy of reserves established in 2020, particularly for the 2018 and 2019 underwriting years. A Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) arrangement, put in place in December 2021, reinsured loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, contributing to stability and enabling these releases. The adequacy of COVID-19 provisions established in 2020 also contributed to the releases.
